aggregate_group_by.sql: SELECT max("scope_node"), count(e0."record_id"), sum("amount") FROM "entity_scoped_item" AS e0 GROUP BY "scope_node"

aggregate_join.sql: SELECT count(e0."record_id") FROM "entity_scoped_item" AS e0 INNER JOIN "entity_scoped_child" AS e1 ON e0."record_id" = e1."item_id"

inner_join.sql: SELECT e0."record_id"::uuid, e0."field_values", e0."deleted", e0."entity_def_version", e0."last_event_global_seq", e0."inserted_at", e0."updated_at", e1."record_id"::uuid, e1."field_values", e1."deleted", e1."entity_def_version", e1."last_event_global_seq", e1."inserted_at", e1."updated_at" FROM "entity_scoped_item" AS e0 INNER JOIN "entity_scoped_child" AS e1 ON e0."record_id" = e1."item_id"

latest_filter.sql: SELECT e0."id", e0."entity_type", e0."record_id", e0."field_values", e0."deleted", e0."entity_def_version", e0."last_event_global_seq", e0."inserted_at", e0."updated_at" FROM "entity_record_latest" AS e0 WHERE (e0."entity_type" = $1) AND (TRUE AND (e0."field_values"->>$2 = $3))

left_join.sql: SELECT e0."record_id"::uuid, e0."field_values", e0."deleted", e0."entity_def_version", e0."last_event_global_seq", e0."inserted_at", e0."updated_at", e1."record_id"::uuid, e1."field_values", e1."deleted", e1."entity_def_version", e1."last_event_global_seq", e1."inserted_at", e1."updated_at" FROM "entity_scoped_item" AS e0 LEFT OUTER JOIN "entity_scoped_child" AS e1 ON e0."record_id" = e1."item_id"

plain.sql: SELECT e0."record_id"::uuid, e0."field_values", e0."deleted", e0."entity_def_version", e0."last_event_global_seq", e0."inserted_at", e0."updated_at" FROM "entity_scoped_item" AS e0

plain_filter_sort.sql: SELECT e0."record_id"::uuid, e0."field_values", e0."deleted", e0."entity_def_version", e0."last_event_global_seq", e0."inserted_at", e0."updated_at" FROM "entity_scoped_item" AS e0 WHERE (TRUE AND ("name" = $1)) ORDER BY "amount"

through_join.sql: SELECT e0."record_id"::uuid, e0."field_values", e0."deleted", e0."entity_def_version", e0."last_event_global_seq", e0."inserted_at", e0."updated_at", e2."record_id"::uuid, e2."field_values", e2."deleted", e2."entity_def_version", e2."last_event_global_seq", e2."inserted_at", e2."updated_at" FROM "entity_scoped_item" AS e0 LEFT OUTER JOIN "entity_scoped_child" AS e1 ON e0."record_id" = e1."item_id" LEFT OUTER JOIN "entity_scoped_item" AS e2 ON e1."item_id" = e2."record_id"
